question: The Borlaug Award is given in the field of:
solution:
The correct answer is **__Agriculture.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Borlaug Award is given in the field of**Agriculture__.**
 
• This Award was created in the year **1972.**
 
• This Award was named in honour of Nobel Laureate Norman E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **MS Swaminathan** was awarded the first World Agriculture Prize.
 
• **Rafi Ahmed Kidwai Award is given for Outstanding Research in Agricultural Sciences** is given to Agricultural Scientists.
 
• **National Award for Excellence for Agricultural Institutions **is the highest Award for agriculture.
